text: Program Description Program Period December 6th.---December 19th . 2026. Cost: 450 USD/Student The cost includes the expenses of the campus dormitory, tuition, course materials, group transportation in Xi’an,on-campus Internet, insurance in China, most cultural experience and visit. *The round-trip transportation expenses, the Ticket of Terra Cotta Warriors, meal fee and other own expenses will be paid by participants. NPU will provide each participant with a meal card, and the fee needs to be topped up by participant according to the personal situation. Camp Arrangement Note：The student apartment is equipped with independent toilet, water heater, public laundry room and kitchen.The schedule above is for reference only. Please refer to the actual schedule for specific arrangements.
